name: level_03_opening
_notes: Timings come from `--recon` on this level: wave 1 spawns between 4.0s and 8.4s, the hostile line
meets the friendly line around 17-22s at world x 650-700, and the camera never scrolls, so the
`ahead` is negative for the move order on purpose. A reposition is only accepted towards the base --
the unit turns around, walks back and suspends combat -- so an order to the right is refused and
would film as a click that did nothing. Pulling the front unit out as the wave closes is the real
tactic and the one worth showing.
Deploys after the first two are gated by energy. The runner holds the cursor where it is until the
card lights and only then sets off, so the approach lands as the card becomes affordable and a
balance change slides the timing rather than breaking the shot. Deploys are scheduled after the
tactical beat so that a long wait cannot delay it.
